name: Aviation Operations Console
description: Explore a fictional airport operations exercise using entirely synthetic, non-operational data.

requirements.text: Load synthetic flights, stands, turnaround milestones, and simulated alerts.
requirements.acceptance: Malformed records appear in a data quality summary.

requirements.text: Display the current exercise clock in UTC.
requirements.acceptance: Pausing the exercise freezes all time-based views.

requirements.text: Filter the exercise by terminal, time range, and flight status.
requirements.acceptance: The board, stand view, and alert list reflect the selected scope.

requirements.text: Show arrivals and departures on a sortable flight board.
requirements.acceptance: Sort order uses scheduled UTC time with a stable flight ID tie-breaker.

requirements.text: Open a flight detail panel from the board.
requirements.acceptance: The panel shows synthetic movement, stand, milestone, and alert references.

requirements.text: Visualize stand assignments across the selected period.
requirements.acceptance: Overlapping assignments render as separate blocks and list the affected flight IDs.
Two occupied intervals that overlap trigger a single conflict per flight pair.

requirements.text: Track turnaround milestones and simulated delay reasons.
requirements.acceptance: A missing milestone is labeled unknown and excluded from completion totals.

requirements.text: Display simulated alert priorities and sources.
requirements.acceptance: Alerts preserve their fictional event IDs and link to affected flight or stand records.
Acknowledging one alert updates its state while retaining its original event and priority.
Reload restores acknowledgements and the exercise timestamps.

requirements.text: Show aggregate activity and stand utilization.
requirements.acceptance: Totals match filtered exercise records and identify incomplete data.

requirements.text: Provide keyboard navigation and readable status labels.
requirements.acceptance: Every view is reachable by keyboard and no status depends on color alone.
The export includes filters, source IDs, alert counts, and the exercise-only label.

requirements.text: Reset the exercise and clear local adjustments.
requirements.acceptance: Reset restores the initial synthetic snapshot and default scope.

requirements.text: Label every view as a synthetic exercise.
requirements.acceptance: The label remains visible on narrow layouts and is included in exports.
